tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster gyi tshe sgrub nyams su len tshul 'chi med bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs// nyi shar padma rā ga'i dmar mdangs kyi// dkyil nas mngon par phyung lta'i bcom ldan 'das// bsgom bzlas rnal 'byor la brten 'chi med tshe// sgrub thabs thang stong rgyal po'i lugs srol 'dri// 'dir tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster gyi sgo nas tshe sgrub pa la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// deng nas byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dkon mchog gsum// kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi// lan gsum sogs ci nus dang*/ sems bskyed ni/ 'gro kun sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las gdon phyir// bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya// gang phyir 'chi bdag bdud las rgyal byed pa'i// dpag med tshe yi dngos grub sgrub la 'jug /ces lan gsum/ tshogs bsags ni/ snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od kyi lcags kyu 'phros// rang bzhin gnas nas bla ma tshe dpag med// gnyis su med la sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis// kun nas bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru ā yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥphyag byas/ gu ru ā yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ tshogs bsags 'di mi nus pas skyabs sems gnyis su bsdur btub bo// tshad med ni/ mkha' mnyam sems can bde ba rgyur bcas spyod// sdug bsngal kun 'byung dag dang bral gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bder gnas phan tshun dag /chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms gnas gyur cig /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod la/ chos rnams rang bzhin spros bral dag pa'i gdangs// ma 'gags dbang sngon zhun ma'i sa gzhi'i dbus// bkod legs rma byas bteg pa'i rin chen khri// chu skyes ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor steng*// hrīḥlas bdag mdun dbyer med bcom ldan 'das// tshe dpag med mgon nyi shar byi ru'i ri// ji bzhin dmar 'od 'phro ba'i mnyam gzhag phyag

/tshe bcud bdud rtsis gtams pa'i bum pa bsnams// dbang gzhu'i dar gos rin chen rgyan gyis spras// dge mtshan lham mer rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// bla ma tho brtsegs su bsgom na/ spyi bor skyabs mchog drin chen chos rje gsum// tshe sbyin mgon por gsal ba'i gtsug nas yar// bkra shis lhun grub rmor chen thams cad mkhyen// ngag dbang lhun grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs gnyis// bstan 'dzin bzang po nam mkha' sangs rgyas gnyis// bsod nams lhun grub ngag chos dbang phyug dpal// nyi zla bzang po kun bzang chos kyi nyi// brtson 'grus bzang po padma saṃ bha wa// rta mchog tshe dpag med pa snang mtha' yas// thams cad tho brtsegs tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur// zhes so// yang na kun 'dus sam khrom tshogs su bsgom na/ spyi bor skyabs mchog drin chen chos rje dang*// dbyer med grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong pa// smug nag khro 'dzum mchog sbyin bum pa bsnams// thugs kar 'dab stong lte bar padma 'byung*// rdo rje thod pa tshe bum mkha' dbyug 'dzin// snyan zhu la sogs rang lugs chas kyis bklubs// de yi thugs kar tshe dpag med mgon dmar// mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin pa rgyan rdzogs sku// de mdun rta mchog nyi ma'i 'od ltar 'tsher// zhal gsum phyag drug sna tshogs mtshon chas brel// drag po'i chas ldan zhabs brgyad klu brgyad brdzis// mtha' skor brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor bar gyur// ces de gnyis gang mos re nyams su blangs mthar/ thugs ka'i 'od kyis bla ma rgyal ba sras// ma lus spyan drangs de dag ro gcig 'dres// de rnams thugs ka'i 'od zer pho nya yis// rang gi bla tshe mi dang mi min gyis// brkus phrogs bcom dang nyams zad 'thor ba dang*// 'byung bzhi snod bcud skye 'gro'i bsod nams tshe// rgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i tshogs// 'chi med bskal par 'tsho byed tshe yi bcud// phyogs bcu kun nas tshur bsdus spyi bo'i lha// bum nang bcas par thim la gsol btab pas// de dag sku yi cha dang bum nang nas// tshe chu'i rgyun babs spyi bo'i gtsug nas zhugs// lus kun khyab pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dag

/'chi med rtag brtan tshe yi dngos grub thob// ces dang*/ tshe ril tshe chang yod pa'i skabs yin na/ tshe rdzas rnams su'ang thim pas nad med tshe// mi shigs bskal par brtan pa'i bcud len gyur// ces brjod do// gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hrīḥhrīḥsnang ba mtha' yas 'gro kun rjes su 'dzin// tshe dpag med mgon sgrub la 'chi med ster// rta mgrin dbang rgyal 'gro ba'i bar chad sel// padma 'byung gnas snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs// thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// mkhas btsun grub pa kun spangs chos kyi rje// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog sde// ngag gi dbang phyug brnyes pa nyi zla bzang*// mkhas btsun chen po dbang phyug dpal bzang dang*// ngag dbang chos grags gangs can mkhas pa'i rje// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dang*// 'dren mchog dam pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas zhabs// nam mkha'

ngor nas brgyud pa/ dpal bzang mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// ngag dbang lhun grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs gnyis/ ngor nas brgyud pa/ ngor nas brgyud pa/ bkra shis lhun grub kun dga' lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// ngag dbang kun legs dge legs rgyal mtshan dpal// tshul khrims rin chen rnam gsum ngor nas brgyud pa/ dbyer med pa'i// skyabs yul kun 'dus drin chen chos rje sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma byin rlabs 'byung gnas dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma la// gsol ba 'debs so 'gal rkyen bar chad sol// byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med dngos grub stsol// zhes pa'i rgyas pa'am mi nus na/ thang stong rgyal por gsol btab bslu ba med// ces pa dang*/ dngos brgyud bla ma byin rlabs 'byung gnas sogs dang sbrel lo/ de nas sngar gyi tshe bcud sdud pa'i dmigs pa de yang yang gsal 'debs bzhin pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi puṇya dzñā na ā yu siddhi dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags grangs ci nus bzlas mthar/ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi// mthu dang nus pa byin rlabs dpung bskyed la// 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'chi med tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsol// 'chi med tshe yi dpal la longs spyod cing*// rig pa'i blo dang rnam 'byed blo gros dang*// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gang lags pa// de kun lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol// de ltar gsol btab spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams// bdud rtsir zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// de yang 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyur// rang la thim pas tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes// zhes brjod la bla ma yi dam rang sems gsum dbyer mi phyed par ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog go

/gsum pa ni/ de las ldang nas gtor ma 'bul ba dang ma 'brel na/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dam chos spyod// mthar thug tshe dpag med mgon mngon gyur nas// 'gro kun de yi go 'phang 'khrid par shog /ces dge ba bsngo/ bsnyen pa sogs kyi skabs gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang mdun bskyed las bye ba'i tshe dpag tu med par gsal bas/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ gyis chos rnams stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang*// āḥlas ye shes thod pa ches yangs par// hūm̐ las sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga// hoḥyis dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// lha'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te bzhes par bsams la/ oṃ gu ru a pa ri mi ta ā yurdzñā na i daṃ ba linta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis mtshan sngags de la badzra arghaṃ sogs btags pa'i nyer spyod dang*/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod la/ bcom ldan bdag sogs byang chub sgrub pa'i tshe// bsod nams blo gros 'phel rgyas dngos grub stsol// mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma ni/ 'bru gsum gyis byin rlabs byas/ pheṃ badzra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki ni sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dṛ shya hoḥs spyan drangs la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ arghaṃ sogs phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod la/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes nas/ kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar dang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ badzra muḥ/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o// de lta bu'i rim pas bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum la sogs pa byas pas/ dus 'dzin gyi chad pa las grol bar 'gyur ba myong bas grub pa'o// bka' gter gdams pa'i 'chi med bcud len gyis// na rgas dben pa'i ring 'tshor sgrub pa'i thabs// bdag blo'i chu gter bsrubs las phyung ba yi// dge bas 'gro rnams tshangs pa'i tshe thob shog

/ces grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster gyi/ tshe sgrub nyams su len tshul 'chi med bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gtsug lag kun gzigs bla ma bde 'byung rnam par rol pa'am/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho pa'i bkas bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa bi dza ya tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
